trello.name: Fix Staging Deploy Job - Registry Token Expired
trello.desc:
Kim: Staging is broken. The deploy job has been red since this morning, it can't pull the base image, looks like the registry token expired. Nobody can test anything until it's fixed.

Ade: That's mine, I rotated tokens yesterday and clearly missed the CI one. I'll regenerate the registry token, update the CI secret, and re-run the deploy. Give me an hour.

trello.name: Send Updated Meridian Proposal to Lena
trello.desc:
Kim: Second thing: Meridian. They asked for the updated proposal with the new pricing, and I promised it end of day today. The numbers are final in the spreadsheet, I just need you to drop them into the proposal doc and send it to their procurement contact, Lena, you have her email from the kickoff thread.

Ade: Updated proposal to Lena by end of day, numbers from the spreadsheet. Fine.
